slug: 2026-02-20 Malawi validates AI strategy, digital transformation policy - CAJ News Africa

facts.fact: Malawi began validating its Draft National AI Strategy at a two-day workshop in Lilongwe led by the Ministry of ICT's Department of E-Government with UNDP, before the strategy is finalised.

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT, Department of E-Government

note: Standing is draft; Department of E-Government leads validation, a body for writing, not for carrying out.
